evidence.value: reported across two independent threads, 2021-2025

source.title: Figma Forum: charging for additional editors; approving editing access results in charges

evidence.note: Tier 5 practitioner evidence, admitted under methodology 2.4: only available evidence of the lived mechanism, contemporaneous, specific and falsifiable. Two independent threads four years apart corroborate. Describes expansion inside an existing paying account, not acquisition of a new customer.

evidence.claim: Real-time multi-user editing over WebSocket with the server as central authority, explicitly not operational transforms and not true CRDTs

source.title: How Figma's multiplayer technology works

evidence.note: Seven years old and the only authoritative architectural source located. Documents its own limits: no simultaneous editing of the same text value, last-writer-wins on conflicting properties, transient object disappearance on concurrent reparenting.

evidence.note: Establishes that browser-native rendering and multiplayer editing were separable decisions taken in sequence, not a single decision.
